init.title: Calibration Required
init.description:
Your Senso4s scale needs to be calibrated to measure gas levels accurately.

**What happens during calibration:**
1. You will remove the gas cylinder from the scale
2. The scale will calibrate itself while empty
3. You will place the cylinder back on the scale
4. The configuration will be saved

Click Submit when you are ready to begin.

remove_cylinder.title: Remove Gas Cylinder
remove_cylinder.description:
**Remove the gas cylinder from the scale now.**

The scale must be completely empty for calibration to work correctly. Make sure nothing is on the scale.

Once the cylinder is removed, click Submit to start calibration.

replace_tank.title: Replace Gas Cylinder
replace_tank.description:
Calibration complete!

Place the gas cylinder back on the scale, then click Submit to write the configuration and verify the reading.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure Home Assistant settings for this device. These settings do not affect the device itself.

refill_tank.title: Refill Tank
refill_tank.description:
Use this when you have refilled or replaced your gas cylinder with the same size tank.

**Place your full tank on the scale before submitting.**

This will update the device with a new measurement start date.

**Remove the gas cylinder from the scale before submitting.**
